tasks.title: Create a CRM from a business description

steps.message: I own a neighbourhood bakery called Rise & Shine. I take custom cake and bread orders, so I need to track my regular customers, their orders (what they ordered, pickup date, whether they have paid), and the products we make.
steps.reply:
I have set up a structure tailored for Rise & Shine Bakery with three entity types: Customer, Product, and Order.

- **Customer**: Tracks customer contact details (Name, Phone, Email).
- **Product**: Tracks items you bake (Name, Category, Price, and Description).

tasks.title: Add an enum (single-choice) field to an existing entity

steps.message: Add a field called 'Referral source' to Customer. It should be a pick-one list with these choices: Walk-in, Referral, Online, Other.
steps.reply: I've proposed adding the 'Referral source' select field to Customer with the options Walk-in, Referral, Online, and Other.

tasks.title: Change a field's type while it holds data

steps.message: On Customer, the 'Phone' field needs to hold longer answers. Change its type to text.
steps.reply: I have updated the 'Phone' field on Customer to be a text field.

tasks.title: Rename a label (keys and data unchanged)

steps.message: Please rename the 'Phone' field on Customer to 'Preferred Phone'. Keep all the existing data.
steps.reply: I have proposed renaming the 'Phone' field on Customer to 'Preferred Phone'. This will keep all your existing customer data intact.

tasks.title: Add a new entity type linked to an existing one

steps.message: I want to keep track of customer feedback. Add a new entity type called 'Feedback' with a rating (a number) and a comment, and link each Feedback to a Customer.
steps.reply: I have set up a new 'Feedback' entity type with 'Rating' and 'Comment' fields, and linked it directly to your 'Customer' records.

tasks.title: Add a link between two existing entity types

steps.message: Each Customer should be linked to a Product. Please add that link.
steps.reply: I have proposed adding a link from Customer to Product. If you would prefer customers to be able to link to multiple products (e.g., favorite products) or would like a different name for this link, let me know!

tasks.title: Remove a field, then restore it

steps.message: We never use the 'Email' field on Customer. Please remove it.
steps.reply: I'll archive the "Email" field on Customer for you. If you ever need it back, it can be restored.

steps.message: Actually I need the 'Email' field on Customer back, please restore it.
steps.reply: I have proposed restoring the Email field on Customer.

tasks.title: Remove a field, then revert (data must come back)

steps.message: Please remove the 'Preferred Phone' field from Customer, we don't use it.
steps.reply: I've proposed archiving the 'Preferred Phone' field from Customer.

tasks.title: Bad requests (duplicate entity, unsupported field type) are refused without damage

steps.message: Create another entity type called 'Customer'.
steps.reply: You already have an entity type named 'Customer', and entity names must be unique. Would you like to use a different name (such as 'Wholesale Customer' or 'Client'), or would you prefer to add fields or adjust the existing Customer entity?

steps.message: Add a field called 'Mood' to Customer with the type 'hologram'.
steps.reply: I can't add a field with the type 'hologram', as supported field types are: text, long_text, number, date, boolean, select, multiselect, email, and phone. Would you like 'Mood' to be a text field, or perhaps a select dropdown with specific options (e.g., Happy, Neutral, Sad)?
